headline: Beats by Dre collaborates with Pokémon for a Pikachu-themed Pill speaker
summary: Following rumors and a mascot visit to Apple Park, Beats has officially teased a special edition of its revived Pill speaker.
details: Beats by Dre has confirmed a collaboration with Pokémon, set to feature a Pikachu-themed Pill speaker. This announcement follows speculation fueled by a mascot's visit to Apple Park and a leaked product image.
The teaser, posted on social media, shows a shadowy silhouette of the Beats Pill speaker with yellow accents, accompanied by the tagline, "Time to catch something new."
The Beats Pill speaker was revived in 2024 and retails for $150. This collaboration aims to generate buzz for the product by leveraging the immense cultural impact of the Pokémon franchise.
While a release date has not yet been announced, the partnership signals a strategic move by Apple to cross-promote its audio brand with a globally recognized entertainment property.
caption:
Pikachu is coming to your playlist! Beats by Dre has officially confirmed a collaboration with Pokémon.

Beats by Dre has confirmed a collaboration with Pokémon, set to feature a Pikachu-themed Pill speaker. This announcement follows speculation fueled by a mascot's visit to Apple Park and a leaked product image.

The teaser, posted on social media, shows a shadowy silhouette of the Beats Pill speaker with yellow accents, accompanied by the tagline, "Time to catch something new."

The Beats Pill speaker was revived in 2024 and retails for $150. This collaboration aims to generate buzz for the product by leveraging the immense cultural impact of the Pokémon franchise.

While a release date has not yet been announced, the partnership signals a strategic move by Apple to cross-promote its audio brand with a globally recognized entertainment property.
